target.title: refactor(anthropic): unify GA 1M model detection with shared capability helper
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Three code paths independently maintain their own lists of "which Anthropic models support 1M context", using different mechanisms:

| File | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| `src/agents/context-resolution.ts` | Hardcoded `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` list |
| `extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.ts` | Second hardcoded `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` list |
| `extensions/anthropic/register.runtime.ts` | `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()` capability helper |

Adding a new 1M model requires updating both hardcoded lists in lockstep. When they drift (as with #100572 for Fable 5), one path recognizes the model as 1M while the other does not — causing silent feature degradation (e.g. missing beta headers, wrong context window).

The immediate trigger was `claude-cli + claude-fable-5` falling back to 200K because the Fable 5 guard in `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` excluded `claude-cli`. But the underlying issue is the duplicated lists, not the missing provider.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace both hardcoded `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` lists with `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()`, the shared capability helper from `packages/llm-core/src/model-contracts/anthropic.ts`. This helper is already the canonical source used by `register.runtime.ts`, multiple provider plugins (Bedrock, Vertex, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry), and the Claude thinking pipeline.

Concrete changes:
- `src/agents/context-resolution.ts`: delete the prefix list; use `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()` for the GA 1M fallback branch. Fable 5 / Mythos 5 / Sonnet 5 guards reliably cover all three Anthropic providers (anthropic, anthropic-vertex, claude-cli) through the outer `isAnthropicProvider` check.
- `extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.ts`: delete the second prefix list; `isAnthropic1MModel()` delegates entirely to the shared helper.

This is a net-negative-LOC refactor (2 files, +16/−39) that makes the 1M model list single-source. Adding a future model like `claude-sonnet-4-7` will only need the regex update in `packages/llm-core`.

## User Impact

All existing behavior is preserved. `claude-cli + claude-fable-5` now correctly resolves to 1M (was the original trigger). All three Anthropic-affiliated providers (anthropic, anthropic-vertex, claude-cli) benefit from the unified detection for all current and future GA 1M models.

## Evidence

### Unit tests (89 passed, 0 failed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/context.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  66 passed (66)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  23 passed (23)
```

### Real behavior proof — `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` live output

A focused proof script exercised `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()` directly against the production build to verify that `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` and related models resolve to the correct 1M context window:

```
=== resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow — Real Behavior Proof ===

  ✓ claude-cli Fable 5 -> 1M
    provider="claude-cli" model="claude-fable-5"
    result=1000000 expected=1000000

  ✓ claude-cli Mythos 5 -> 1M
    provider="claude-cli" model="claude-mythos-5"
    result=1000000 expected=1000000

  ✓ claude-cli Sonnet 5 -> 1M
    provider="claude-cli" model="claude-sonnet-5"
    result=1000000 expected=1000000

  ✓ claude-cli Opus 4.8 -> 1M
    provider="claude-cli" model="claude-opus-4-8-20260514"
    result=1048576 expected=1048576

  ✓ claude-cli Sonnet 4.6 -> 1M
    provider="claude-cli" model="claude-sonnet-4-6"
    result=1048576 expected=1048576

  ✓ anthropic Fable 5 -> 1M
    provider="anthropic" model="claude-fable-5"
    result=1000000 expected=1000000

  ✓ anthropic-vertex Fable 5 -> 1M
    provider="anthropic-vertex" model="claude-fable-5"
    result=1000000 expected=1000000

  ✓ openai gpt-5.5 -> undefined (not Anthropic)
    provider="openai" model="gpt-5.5"
    result=undefined expected=undefined

  ✓ claude-cli Haiku 4.5 -> undefined (not 1M)
    provider="claude-cli" model="claude-haiku-4-5"
    result=undefined expected=undefined

9/9 assertions passed
✓ All assertions passed — claude-cli/claude-fable-5 resolves to 1M context window
```

Key coverage:
- **claude-cli GA 1M models**: Fable 5, Mythos 5, Sonnet 5 → all resolve to their correct 1M constants
- **claude-cli GA 1M via shared helper**: Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6 → both resolve through `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()` to 1,048,576
- **Provider boundary**: anthropic, anthropic-vertex, claude-cli all return the correct fixed window
- **Non-Anthropic**: openai returns undefined (correct)
- **Non-1M Anthropic**: claude-haiku-4-5 returns undefined (correct)

Behavior addressed: fragmented GA 1M model detection across context-resolution, stream-wrappers, and register.runtime
Real environment tested: Linux Node 24, commit ba64fc14ed, branch fix/gap-ctx-claude-cli-fable5-context-window
Exact command run after this patch: `npx tsx scripts/proof-context-resolution.mjs` (exercising `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` from production source)
Evidence after fix: 9/9 assertions passed; `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking` is the single source of truth for GA 1M model detection; two duplicated prefix lists eliminated
Observed result after fix: All tests pass; claude-cli/claude-fable-5 correctly resolves to 1,000,000 token context window
What was not tested: Live gateway end-to-end with actual claude-cli provider subscription (requires Claude CLI subscription and API key)
